channel.title: The Drafting Room
channel.description: Papers and Drafting Notes from Redrafting America on constitutional design, institutional resilience, and the work of building Constitution v2.0.

item.title: Drafting Note: Bots on the Street
item.author: info@redraftingamerica.org (Redrafting America)
item.description: We asked ten artificial intelligences one human question: What does “Redrafting America” mean to you?

item.title: Paper: Founder’s Introduction
item.author: info@redraftingamerica.org (Todd McGuckin)
item.description: Why Redrafting America began, why resilient institutions matter more than perfect leaders, and why Constitution v2.0 is an invitation rather than a final word.

item.title: Paper: America at 250: Honoring the Past. Designing the Future.
item.author: info@redraftingamerica.org (Todd McGuckin)
item.description: A manifesto for honoring America’s founding spirit by designing stronger institutions for the nation’s next 250 years.

item.title: Paper: Godwin’s Law
item.author: info@redraftingamerica.org (Todd McGuckin)
item.description: A historical warning about authoritarian patterns and the responsibility to act before democratic institutions fail.

item.title: Paper: A Call to the People: Defend Our Republic on Independence Day
item.author: info@redraftingamerica.org (Todd McGuckin)
item.description: A peaceful call to defend the Republic, restore democratic accountability, and strengthen the Constitution.
